title: Guarded
summary: GUARD'ED, participle passive Defended; protected; accompanied by a guard; provided with means of defense. 1. Cautions; circumspect. He was guarded in his expressions. 2. Framed or uttered with caution

inlines.v: GUARD'ED, participle passive Defended; protected; accompanied by a guard; provided with means of defense. 1. Cautions; circumspect. He was guarded in his expressions. 2. Framed or uttered with caution; as, his expressions were guarded
